title: 第7章 小娘子可有婚配第8章 解除婚约
lines: 陆铭章下了朝，习惯到福兴楼小坐半日，只要他来，二楼就是他的。
但他也不是每日来，隔三日来一趟，是以，这福兴楼总会提前把地方空出，迎他。
他到外面饮酒不为别的，就想自在清静，无人搅扰。
碰上雨天，愈添兴致。
一楼堂间的笑语传到他的耳中，菩萨，财神爷……
那尊“菩萨”
坐到窗边，手肘支在桌上，衣袖褪到臂弯，露出一截莹白丰腴的腕子，腕子上戴着一个剔透玉镯和一个素圈银镯。
手掌托着下颌，尖尖的指有一下无一下地点着腮颊。
雨下大了，吹进来，湿了他的袍角，兴许出于好奇，她抬头探着眼，往他这方看来。
她看不见他，不过她这一动，倒叫他看清她的面目。
陆铭章笑着摇了摇头，是个小丫头。
他端起酒盏小酌，把心神入到雨里，再空下来。
安静的雨声里又有了动静，她敛衣屈蹲着，向农妇询问天气，腔音柔缓，夹着外地的口音，有些特别，陆铭章不禁想，这调子只怕发狠也是不能。
不知觉中雨缓了下来，他下了楼走到酒楼外，立在屋檐下，听了一套生意经。
戴缨侧目间，同那人的目光撞上，怔了怔，出于礼节，嘴角带起弧度，福了福身。
然而她发现对面那人，面无表情，眼神清浅，没有任何回应，哪怕连颔首也无。
在戴缨看来，这文人并不是个讨喜的，只一眼，就让人生出不近人情之感，当下也冷了脸，吩咐归雁：“去把饭钱付了。”
归雁应下，进去付了钱，不一会儿出来，扶着戴缨上了马车，远去了。
待人走后，长安瞥向他家阿郎，问道：“阿郎可要回府？”
陆铭章点了点头。
次日，天空放晴，湛蓝一片，太阳挂起，晨光熹微却已带上热度。
归雁招了几名丫鬟进屋，服侍戴缨起身洗漱。
谢家上下忙碌起来，因着今日要去青山寺祈福。
戴万如母女从头饰到衣衫无不精心装扮。
谢山这个家主虽不象妻女那般喜形于色，心里终不似往日平静，毕竟得见陆相一面，已是天赐机缘，若是能近前拜见，再得两句提点……衙部的同僚们看他就会不一样。
这还在其次，主要是陆家千金要见戴缨，好在戴缨那丫头有些自知，想来不会有碍。
谢家一行人出了府门，乘上马车，前后奴仆跟随，呼啦啦往城外驶去。
戴缨揭开车帘，往外看，路上游人不断，有男有女，有老有少，皆是初八这日往寺庙上香祈福。
柔风阵阵，风中带着潮湿的青草香，还混着一点点泥腥气，行人、马车纷纷踏着香尘。
走了好一会儿，到了青山寺，戴缨同谢珍在奴仆的搀扶中落车。
山脚下很热闹，有售卖香烛的、有售卖祈福物件的，还有算命解签的。
一行人拾级而上，先进寺庙烧香祈福，戴缨另向僧祝请奉了几本经书，归家后为亡母诵读。
出了寺门，不知从哪里走来几名锦衣妇人，上前向谢山和戴万如福身见礼。
“仆妇们特特在这儿候着，可算把大人和夫人等来了，咱们老夫人一早念叨想见见贵府的小娘子……”
仆妇说着往四周看，目光落在戴缨身上，忽闪了一下。
content_en:
After Lu Mingzhang went to court, he used to sit in Fuxing Tower for half a day. As long as he came, the second floor would be his.
But he doesn't come every day, but only every three days. Therefore, the Fuxing Building always vacates the space in advance to welcome him.
He went out to drink for no other reason than to be at ease and quiet without being disturbed.
On a rainy day, it becomes even more interesting.
The laughter in the hall on the first floor reached his ears, Bodhisattva, God of Wealth...
That "Bodhisattva"
He sat by the window, resting his elbows on the table, and slid his sleeves down to his arms, revealing a plump white wrist. On his wrist was a clear jade bracelet and a plain silver bracelet.
The palm of his hand was holding his chin, and his pointed fingers were tapping his cheeks.
The rain was falling hard, blowing in and wetting the corners of his robe. Perhaps out of curiosity, she raised her head and looked in his direction.
She couldn't see him, but her movement made him see her face clearly.
Lu Mingzhang smiled and shook his head, she was a little girl.
He picked up his wine cup and sipped, then let his mind wander into the rain, and then became empty again.
There was movement again in the quiet sound of rain. She folded her clothes and squatted down, asking the peasant woman about the weather. Her voice was soft and slow, with an accent from other places, which was a bit special. Lu Mingzhang couldn't help but think that this tone could not be harsh even if it was harsh.
Unconsciously, the rain subsided. He went downstairs and walked outside the restaurant. He stood under the eaves and listened to a set of business tips.
Dai Ying glanced sideways and met the man's eyes. She was startled. Out of courtesy, she curved the corners of her mouth to bless her body.
However, she found that the person opposite had an expressionless face, clear eyes, and no response, not even a nod.
In Dai Ying's opinion, this scholar was not a lovable person. Just one glance made him feel inhumane. He immediately turned cold and told Gui Yan: "Go and pay for the meal."
Gui Yan agreed, went in and paid, came out soon, helped Dai Ying get into the carriage, and drove away.
After the people left, Changan glanced at his Alang and asked, "Alang, do you want to go back home?"
Lu Mingzhang nodded.
…
The next day, the sky cleared up and turned blue. The sun rose, and the morning light was dim but already warm.
Gui Yan invited several maids into the house to help Dai Ying get up and wash up.
Everyone in the Xie family was busy because they were going to Qingshan Temple to pray for blessings today.
Dai Wanru, mother and daughter, dressed up everything from headwear to clothes.
Although Xie Shan, the head of the family, is not as happy as his wife and daughter, his heart is not as calm as before. After all, it is a God-given opportunity to meet Lu Xiang. If he can come to see him, he can give him a few words of advice... His colleagues in the Yamen Department will look at him differently.
This is second to none. The main reason is that the daughter of the Lu family wants to see Dai Ying. Fortunately, that girl Dai Ying is somewhat self-aware, so it won't be a hindrance.
The Xie family left the mansion, got on the carriage, followed by their servants, and drove out of the city.
Dai Ying opened the car curtain and looked outside. There were many tourists on the road, including men and women, old and young. They all went to the temple to offer incense and pray for blessings on the eighth day of the lunar month.
There was a soft breeze, carrying the fragrance of moist green grass, mixed with a little muddy smell, and pedestrians and carriages stepped on the fragrance.
After walking for a long time, they arrived at Qingshan Temple. Dai Ying and Xie Zhen got out of the car with the help of servants.
The foot of the mountain is very lively, with people selling incense and candles, prayer objects, and fortune tellers.
The group of people climbed up the stairs and went to the temple to burn incense and pray for blessings. Dai Ying also asked the monk Zhu to give him some scriptures and read them to his deceased mother after returning home.
After leaving the temple gate, several women in brocade clothes came out of nowhere and came forward to greet Xie Shan and Dai Wanru Fu.
"The servants and ladies are waiting here very much. They are waiting for the master and his wife. Our old lady has been talking about wanting to meet your lady in the morning..."
The servant woman said and looked around, her eyes fell on Dai Ying and flickered for a moment.
title_en: Chapter 7 Is the young lady married? Chapter 8 Dissolution of engagement
